notes: Every place the mod touches Minecraft (Forge 1.20.1).

rows.purpose: Match world: flat-ish generated battle maps, no mobs, no weather damage
One lightweight entity per unit for networking/visibility; sim owns state
Draw extracted TABS meshes skinned to ragdoll pose; icons when zoomed out
Free top-down camera with strategic zoom
Mouse picking, box select, orders, rebindable keys
Resource bar, minimap, build menu, selection panel
Physics ground + walls, refreshed when blocks change
Buildings as block structures per race/level

rows.mc_api: Local resource pack + mod config dir
rows.purpose: Extracted TABS meshes/textures/sounds from the player's install
Orders client->server; batched unit snapshots server->client
Apply performance fps caps during matches
